article_content: In an awkward situation, two 15-year-old boys required rescuing from a rubber dinghy close to the shore after they underestimated the tide and got stuck on mudflats. The incident occurred on Sunday afternoon on the River Medway in Gillingham, Kent, prompting the coastguard's intervention. The friends, equipped with life jackets and a two-way radio, had launched their dinghy from a sailing boat owned by one of their fathers. The Medway Coastguard team and a specialist mud rescue unit arrived at the scene around 3 p.m. to winch the boys to safety. Video footage shows a rescuer wading through the mud to reach the stranded pair and secure them with a rope. Fire engines also responded, and firefighters were seen observing and chuckling as the teenagers sat helplessly in their immobile boat. Richard Rodgers, the deputy station officer for the Medway Coastguard team, noted that the boys had all the necessary safety gear but were simply caught out by the tide. He added that a nearby yacht club had alerted them to the situation, and the boys were slightly cold upon returning to shore but were checked by paramedics and found to be okay.

article_content: Phil Neville has revealed that Manchester United were 'really interested' in signing Blaise Matuidi when his contract was expiring last season. The Paris Saint-Germain midfielder impressed against Chelsea on Tuesday night and assisted Edinson Cavani's equalizing goal. Neville, who served as a coach under David Moyes at Old Trafford, mentioned in an interview with BBC Radio 5 Live that United tried to acquire the Frenchman. Manchester United were 'really interested' in signing PSG midfielder Blaise Matuidi (pictured) last season. Phil Neville (pictured) coached under David Moyes at Old Trafford when they aimed to sign the Frenchman. He said: 'We wanted to sign him. We'd heard his contract was expiring, and we were very interested in him. Then he signed a contract with PSG, which was something we weren't pleased about. We were looking at bringing him to Man Utd last year to inject some energy into the midfield. He's a box-to-box player, and he drives the team forward with his energy on that left side'. Matuidi joined PSG from Saint-Étienne in 2011 and has since established himself as one of the top midfielders in world football. With United lacking midfielders and often playing Wayne Rooney in a deeper role, Matuidi would be a valuable addition to Louis van Gaal's squad. The Frenchman assisted Edinson Cavani's equaliser against Chelsea and celebrated with the goalscorer. The dynamic midfielder would be a great fit for United's struggling midfield.

article_content: Gold Coast Councillor Chris Robbins reports receiving threats of gang rape and death related to a proposed mosque. The Gold Coast City councillor says she has been threatened with gang rape and death over a proposed mosque, and she alleges Facebook is protecting the identity of her tormentors. Chris Robbins states she has spent weeks attempting to get Facebook to reveal the identity of the creators of the 'Stop the Mosque at Currumbin' page after it used her photo as its profile picture. The page claimed she was receiving money from unspecified Islamic backers, an allegation she denies. After Ms. Robbins engaged a lawyer who threatened Facebook with defamation, the photo was removed. However, the page and user comments containing violent threats remain. Cr Robbins said she became a target of protesters after council received an application to build a mosque at an industrial site in Currumbin, located on the southern end of Queensland's Gold Coast. 'Horrific vilification' and threats were directed at her after she attended a meeting and stated that council had received a mosque application and would assess it as legally required, she explained. She added, 'That essentially peeved some people who wanted me to stand up and say that at the end of the day this wouldn't happen.' The controversy surrounding the proposed development intensified after it received support at a council planning committee meeting on Wednesday. Cr Robbins reiterates that she has spent several weeks trying to get Facebook to reveal the identity of the creators of the 'Stop the Mosque at Currumbin' page after it used her photo as its profile picture, falsely claiming she was receiving money from unspecified Islamic backers, a claim she denies. According to the Brisbane Times, the Gold Coast City Council's planning committee has recommended converting an abandoned factory at Currumbin Waters into an Islamic mosque but has rejected an application for 4 a.m. prayers due to widespread objections from residents. Committee members discussed the social impact, parking, and noise of the proposed 4 a.m. morning prayers for three hours on Wednesday morning. Cr Robbins, who voted against the proposal on Wednesday, believes the lack of accountability for the Facebook page's authors is appalling and demonstrates how easily people can target victims through social media with little fear of consequences. 'I'm very upset that the social media platform has taken no responsibility,' she stated. She continued, 'If you want to make the people who posted to take responsibility for it, Facebook won't tell you who they are. That's what really peeves me because I would take legal action against those people for vilifying me.' 'I can't take on Facebook. I don't have the money to take on Facebook in the USA.' 'Facebook is allowing those individuals to hide their identity and to vilify, libel, and threaten people like me. That's okay, I can handle it, but what if I'm 15? This is a terrible thing.' The proposed mosque will be constructed in Currumbin, south of Queensland's Gold Coast. Cr Robbins, who acknowledges some legitimate community concerns about the proposal, asserts that a final decision on whether the mosque application is approved will be based solely on planning grounds. Queensland police are also investigating death threats made against Cameron Caldwell and William Owen-Jones, two of the five councillors who approved the planning proposal. After Wednesday's meeting, the Facebook page published contact details for all five councillors, labeling them 'traitors' and urging followers to contact them with their views. A full council meeting will decide the application's fate next Tuesday, September 16. Comment was sought from Facebook.

article_content: United States women's national team goalkeeper Hope Solo has been suspended for 30 days by US Soccer following an incident during a training camp. The governing body did not provide specific details about the incident but confirmed that the 33-year-old would be ineligible for the matches against France and England in February. 'U.S. Soccer has suspended goalkeeper Hope Solo from the U.S. Women's National Team for 30 days,' according to a statement on www.ussoccer.com. 'The suspension is effective immediately.' Hope Solo, the United States women's national team goalkeeper, has been suspended by US Soccer after an incident in training. 'The suspension stems from an incident that occurred during the current WNT training camp in Carson, California.' 'As a result of the suspension, Solo has been released from training camp and will miss the USA's matches in Europe against France on February 8 and England on February 13.' The Seattle Reign goalkeeper is no stranger to controversy and earlier this month domestic violence charges against her were dropped after she pleaded not guilty. She also failed a doping test before the London Olympics in 2012 and received a public warning from the US Anti-Doping Agency after they accepted her explanation. Solo, 33, was recently involved in a domestic violence case but the charges against her were dropped. 'During our current National Team camp, Hope made a poor decision that has resulted in a negative impact on U.S. Soccer and her teammates,' said United States head coach Jill Ellis. 'We feel that it is best for her to step away from the team at this time.' Solo apologized for her actions and pledged to return ready for this summer's World Cup in Canada. 'I accept and respect the Federation's decision, and more importantly, I apologize for disappointing my teammates, coaches and the Federation who have always supported me,' according to a statement on her official Facebook page. 'I think it's best for me to take a break, decompress from the stress of the last several months, and come back mentally and physically ready to positively contribute to the team.' Solo's suspension means that she will miss the upcoming matches against France and England in February.

Hukumar ba ta bayar da cikakken bayani game da lamarin ba, amma ta tabbatar da cewa 'yar wasan mai shekaru 33 ba za ta cancanci buga wasannin da za su kara da Faransa da Ingila a watan Fabrairu ba. Kwanan nan dai Solo, mai shekaru 33, ta shiga wani lamari na tashin hankali a cikin gida amma an wanke ta daga zargin. article_content: Miley Cyrus, the teen star-turned-'bad girl', has once again stirred controversy, this time by impersonating Michele Bachmann and mocking the federal government shutdown on Saturday Night Live. The 20-year-old pop singer's skit involved twerking in revealing clothing, parodying her song 'We Can't Stop' while portraying the conservative Tea Party politician in a video titled 'We Did Stop The Government'. SNL cast member Taran Killam played House Speaker John Boehner, dancing alongside Cyrus in his underwear and a white tank top. The lyrics included lines like, 'If you're not ready for healthcare, can we get a hell no? 'Cause we're gonna keep it shut down, DC is a closed town'. The skit also included lyrics such as, 'This is our House, this is our rules and we did stop the government' and 'If you're not ready for healthcare can we get a hell no, cuz we're gonna keep it shut down. DC is a closed town'. Michele Bachmann was recently involved in a scandal when Iowa state Senator Kent Sorenson resigned after an investigation found he likely violated ethics rules by accepting money from political entities connected to her and then denying it. In the skit, Cyrus wore an all-black outfit, a more conservative look than usual, as she parodied Michele Bachmann. While Cyrus delivered two impressive musical performances on Saturday Night Live, her sketches received mixed reviews. Democrats claim that Speaker Boehner and his Republican colleagues in the House forced the government shutdown in an attempt to defund ObamaCare, the health care law passed largely by Democrats in 2009. The controversial music video parody featured Cyrus and Killam twerking, sticking out their tongues, and throwing dollar bills around the room. article_content: Clive Goodman, previously a royal editor for The News of the World, was seen leaving the Old Bailey after providing evidence. Police initially kept the extent of phone hacking at the News of the World private, showing 'discretion' for victims like the royal family, the court was told. Goodman maintained he was always 'open and honest', even when faced with evidence he repeatedly hacked the phones of Kate Middleton, Prince William, and Prince Harry. He described himself as merely a 'spear carrier' compared to a colleague who, according to court testimony, sourced almost every significant story through phone tampering. Goodman, aged 56 and from Addlestone, Surrey, was fired in 2007 and jailed for hacking royal aides with private investigator Glenn Mulcaire. He testified again under questioning by Andy Coulson’s lawyer, denying he withheld information about his phone hacking when appealing his dismissal. Goodman stated the police and CPS decided against publishing details in 2006/07 to protect the privacy of victims, and that this information only surfaced later. He insisted he has admitted to his actions and paid a 'high price'. Goodman is currently on trial with Coulson for conspiring to commit misconduct by paying police for information. He admitted to hacking Kate Middleton’s phone, including listening to a message from Prince William about being ambushed during a night exercise. Goodman suggested both he and Glenn Mulcaire may have hacked the Duchess's phone, noting it was a continuous occurrence. Timothy Langdale QC accused Goodman of not fully disclosing his hacking while trying to involve others. The court heard Goodman hacked Prince William and Kate Middleton’s phones nearly 200 times and Prince Harry’s voicemails nine times. Goodman claimed the full extent of his activities wasn't revealed because it wasn't part of his dismissal appeal. He described his interaction with News International executives as a 'hostile confrontation'. The Duchess of Cambridge was reportedly first hacked in December 2005 by Goodman. Goodman denied contradicting a 2006 draft statement about a colleague knowing about payments to Glenn Mulcaire. He said he had a 'straight forward story' from the beginning. Goodman returned to court after recovering from a heart condition and pneumonia. The trial continues for former editors Rebekah Brooks, Andy Coulson, and five others, who all deny the charges. Mr Justice Saunders informed the jury about Goodman’s health issues and the need for regular breaks during his testimony.
translated_content: An ga Clive Goodman, tsohon editan sarauta na jaridar News of the World, yana barin Old Bailey bayan ya bada shaida. 'Yan sanda sun fara ɓoye girman kutsen waya a jaridar News of the World, suna nuna 'hikima' ga waɗanda abin ya shafa kamar iyalan sarauta, an faɗa a kotu. Goodman ya ci gaba da cewa koyaushe yana 'buɗe da gaskiya', ko da lokacin da aka fuskance shi da shaidar cewa ya yi kutse akai-akai a wayoyin Kate Middleton, Prince William, da Prince Harry. Ya bayyana kansa a matsayin 'mai ɗaukar mashi' idan aka kwatanta da wani abokin aiki wanda, a cewar shaidar kotu, ya samo kusan kowane labari mai mahimmanci ta hanyar yin kutsen waya. Goodman, mai shekaru 56 daga Addlestone, Surrey, an kore shi a shekarar 2007 kuma an daure shi saboda kutsen mataimakan sarauta tare da mai bincike mai zaman kansa Glenn Mulcaire. Ya sake ba da shaida a ƙarƙashin tambayoyi daga lauyan Andy Coulson, yana musantawa cewa ya ɓoye bayani game da kutsen wayarsa lokacin da yake ɗaukaka ƙara game da korarsa. Goodman ya bayyana cewa 'yan sanda da CPS sun yanke shawarar kin wallafa cikakkun bayanai a shekarar 2006/07 don kare sirrin waɗanda abin ya shafa, kuma waɗannan bayanan sun bayyana ne kawai daga baya. Ya dage cewa ya yarda da ayyukansa kuma ya biya 'babban farashi'. A halin yanzu ana shari'ar Goodman tare da Coulson saboda haɗa baki don aikata rashin da'a ta hanyar biyan 'yan sanda don bayani. Ya yarda da yin kutse a wayar Kate Middleton, gami da sauraron saƙo daga Prince William game da yin kwanton bauna yayin wani atisayen dare. Goodman ya nuna cewa shi da Glenn Mulcaire sun yi kutse a wayar Duchess, yana mai lura cewa lamarin ya ci gaba. Timothy Langdale QC ya zargi Goodman da rashin bayyana cikakken kutsen da ya yi yayin da yake kokarin shigar da wasu. Kotun ta ji cewa Goodman ya yi kutse a wayoyin Prince William da Kate Middleton kusan sau 200 kuma ya yi kutse a sakonnin muryar Prince Harry sau tara. Goodman ya yi iƙirarin cewa ba a bayyana cikakken girman ayyukansa ba saboda ba ya cikin ɗaukaka ƙarar korar sa. Ya bayyana hulɗarsa da manyan jami’an News International a matsayin ‘musayar adawa’. An ruwaito cewa Goodman ya fara kutse a wayar Duchess ta Cambridge a watan Disamba na 2005. Goodman ya musanta cewa ya saɓa wa wata daftarin sanarwa ta 2006 game da wani abokin aiki da ya san game da biyan kuɗi ga Glenn Mulcaire. Ya ce yana da ‘labari madaidaiciya’ tun daga farko. Goodman ya koma kotu bayan ya warke daga ciwon zuciya da kuma ciwon huhu. Shari’ar ta ci gaba da gudana ga tsoffin editocin Rebekah Brooks, Andy Coulson, da wasu biyar, waɗanda dukansu suka musanta zargin. Mista Justice Saunders ya sanar da juri game da matsalolin lafiyar Goodman da kuma buƙatar a sami hutu akai-akai yayin shaidarsa.

article_content: Gregg Wallace, now 50, is set to tie the knot for the fourth time, this time with 29-year-old Anne-Marie Sterpini. Known just as much for his romantic entanglements as for his long-standing role on 'Masterchef,' Wallace's personal life has often been a topic of public interest. Wallace once famously referred to himself as 'the cooking woman's crumpet' and, just a year ago, openly discussed how younger women were attracted to him. However, the narrative has shifted, and the spotlight now falls on whether he has finally found lasting love. Having been in a relationship with Sterpini since March 2013, Wallace asserts he's never felt happier. But his journey to this point has been marked by three previous marriages and numerous publicized relationships. His past is dotted with romances featuring significant age gaps and very public displays of affection, sometimes even via Twitter flirtations. Over the past five decades, Wallace's romantic escapades have included three marriages, widespread declarations of love, and considerable media attention, including critical commentary from former partners. Wallace's first marriage was to Christine in 1991 when he was 24. They married in a quick, 20-minute ceremony and celebrated at a pie and mash shop, but the marriage ended just six weeks later. Wallace himself described it as 'possibly the shortest marriage in the world' in his autobiography, 'Life On A Plate,' admitting he knew it was a mistake even before the vows. In 1993, he met Denise, a pastry chef, and they quickly fell in love, resulting in the birth of their son Tom in 1994, followed by their daughter Libby three years later. Despite having children, they only married in 1999 but divorced in 2004 after Wallace had an affair with an employee. The divorce deeply affected Denise, who required hospitalization. Wallace was granted custody of their children. She later described the breakup as making her a 'nervous wreck'. Denise gave a candid account of their marriage in 2009, alleging that Wallace admitted to sleeping with a prostitute and collected explicit magazines. Earlier this year, she told The Mirror that marrying Wallace was a regret and that he was a 'horrible' person beneath his charming exterior. After the divorce, Wallace moved to Whitstable with his children. In 2009, he met Heidi Brown, 17 years his junior, after she contacted him on Twitter. Their online flirting led to a date at the Baftas, and Heidi soon moved in with Wallace, leaving her job as a biology teacher. Wallace credited Heidi with improving his diet, reducing his alcohol consumption, and providing stability for his children. They married in a lavish ceremony, selling the photos to Hello! magazine for a substantial sum. However, the marriage lasted only 14 months. Heartbroken after the split, Wallace sought counseling. He claimed the breakup wasn't his decision, as he missed taking his 'sexy, elegant wife' to fancy restaurants. Despite the divorce, Heidi remained in their home to care for Wallace's children while he moved to London. Shortly after, Wallace met Carla Franco at the Ideal Home Show in Glasgow. Their flirtation began on Twitter, with Carla joking that she 'could be the next Mrs. Wallace'. However, the relationship ended after five months because Wallace admitted he hadn't moved on from Heidi. Carla claimed Wallace constantly compared her to Heidi, who he described as having 'everything, beauty and intelligence'. Four months after splitting with Franco, Wallace began dating Anne-Marie Sterpini, whom he also met on Twitter. Despite an incident in 2012 where Wallace punched someone for allegedly touching Sterpini, the couple appears to be thriving. He has expressed embarrassment about their age difference but claims to have found his true love. Wallace stated that he knew he truly liked Anne-Marie when her messiness didn't bother him, unlike the belongings of others in the past. He said, 'With her, I like it.'

article_content: Everyone's favorite charmer, George Clooney, is preparing to portray a hired assassin trying to leave the profession after one final assignment in 'The American.' The film is set for release in September, and it's about time Clooney offered some competition to James Bond! He's charismatic, cheeky, and looks fantastic in a suit – what could go wrong? In celebration of this new role, we've compiled a list of the sexiest male spies of all time! Prepare for the 'spy who shagged me' references. Clive Owen sizzled on screen alongside Julia Roberts in 'Duplicity,' playing rival spies engaged in both espionage and romantic tension. He embodies the ideal spy, relying on charm and intelligence rather than extravagant gadgets. Matt Damon delivered a stellar performance as Jason Bourne in 'The Bourne Identity' and its sequels. As a government assassin with amnesia, Damon navigates an identity crisis while evading the CIA. He subverts the classic playboy spy stereotype with his youthful appearance and loyalty to his love interest. It's difficult to definitively name the sexiest Bond, but Pierce Brosnan excelled in 1995's 'Goldeneye.' His British accent and refined chivalry made it easy to understand why women were drawn to him, even when they were meant to apprehend him. Plus, Brosnan is undeniably handsome. I'd almost forgotten how dashing Harrison Ford was in his prime, but he captivated audiences in 1992's 'Patriot Games.' As a retired CIA agent, Harrison is compelled to undertake one last mission when a political group threatens his family. The combination of spy and family man makes him even more appealing! His character is witty and passionate, and while Chris Pine reprised the role in 2014's 'Jack Ryan: Shadow Recruit' (formerly 'Moscow'), Ford remains irreplaceable. The primary draw of 'Mr. and Mrs. Smith' was the palpable chemistry between Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie. As husband and wife who are also rival spies, they generated incredible sexual tension that occasionally manifested in explosive ways. Sean Connery, arguably the most iconic James Bond, set a high standard in films like 1967's 'You Only Live Twice,' where Bond applies his espionage skills in Japan to locate a missing rocket. Young, fit, and possessing a Scottish accent, he effortlessly charmed the women of Japan. In the classic film 'Charade,' Cary Grant portrays a government official with shifting identities who offers assistance to Audrey Hepburn in locating her deceased husband's fortune, which was stolen from the government during World War II. A fraudulent CIA agent and a collection of suspicious individuals believe Hepburn's character knows the money's location and relentlessly pursue her until the mystery is resolved. Embrace the Cold War spy antics! Amidst the Scientology discussions, it's easy to overlook Tom Cruise's past as a heartthrob. However, in 1996, he delivered a convincing performance as a spy in 'Mission: Impossible.' The gravity-defying stunts, black leather attire, and futuristic gadgets established Cruise as an outstanding action star, and it remains to be seen if he can recapture that magic in 'Knight and Day,' where he plays a secret agent. In one of the first Bond films that garnered significant female attention, Daniel Craig introduced new dimensions to 007 in 'Casino Royale.' He was somewhat rougher than previous Bonds, but his attractive blue swim trunks compensated for his ruggedness. He embodies a sensitive bad boy, falling for the wrong women and narrowly escaping death. We're still captivated.

article_content: The Tesla Model 3 'Highland' features the new Tesla badging on the liftgate. An updated version of Tesla’s least expensive vehicle, the Model 3, is expected to arrive in the U.S. soon. The exact launch date in the U.S. remains unknown, but the 'Highland' is currently available in major global markets, including the UK, Germany, Australia, and China. Its arrival in the U.S. is anticipated shortly. (It’s already been spotted in California.) A significant advantage of the Model 3 is its price. Starting at under $39,000, it's Tesla’s most affordable vehicle and is priced almost $9,000 lower than the average transaction price for a new vehicle as of September 2023, according to Kelley Blue Book. “Tesla’s price reductions have impacted the market, driving electric vehicle (EV) prices down by more than 22% year-over-year, from $65,295 to $50,683,” Kelley Blue Book reported. Compared to September 2022, Tesla transaction prices have decreased by 24.7%, according to KBB. “Tesla Model 3 prices have fallen by more than 26% year-over-year to $41,484, placing it well below the average luxury car price. Tesla's average transaction prices are now less than those of Acura, Lexus, Infiniti, and Volvo,” KBB noted. A concise overview of the Model 3 'Highland': it has been refined rather than completely redesigned. The Singapore-based review (accessible below on X/Twitter) is commendably brief and informative, unlike many lengthy YouTube car reviews. The review highlights the new Aero wheels, Hardware 4 cameras, stalkless steering wheel, new ambient lighting, and rear passenger touchscreen. Additional enhancements not covered in the brief review include acoustic glass and improved hood aerodynamics for a quieter ride. Another important aspect not mentioned is range. Motor Trend suggests that the rear-wheel-drive Tesla Model 3 Standard Range may have a lower range rating than the 2023 Model 3 it replaces, while the Long Range version might exceed the 2023 Model 3's range. The Tesla Model 3 Highland features sharper headlights and redesigned tail lights.

article_content: An Arizona civil rights activist says he accepts Katt Williams' apology for an anti-Mexican rant during a comedy show in Phoenix last weekend, but he's calling on the comedian to return to the city to 'demonstrate his commitment to the Latino community'. 'What he said was borderline hate speech and racially offensive,' said Rev. Jarrett Maupin, who is organizing a boycott of Williams' stand-up act. He added that his words could also create 'violence and tension' in the community. Williams, an African-American comedian known more for his erratic behavior than his jokes in recent months, issued a written statement through his publicist on Wednesday that included an apology. 'My remarks were not intended to be offensive,' Williams said. 'I want to apologize if my comedy act was taken out of context'. 'I sincerely appreciate my fans within the Mexican community and would never intentionally go out of my way to offend them,' he added. Video of the rant, delivered during a performance at the Celebrity Theatre on Saturday night, was posted online. Williams singled out a man seated near the stage and asked him if he was Mexican. 'It appears to me that you all like it over here a lot,' Williams then said. He then launched into his tirade. 'Do you remember when white people used to say, 'Go back to Africa,' and we'd have to tell them we don't want to? So if you love Mexico, get the (expletive) over there!' Williams said to the man. As the rant turned into a profanity-laced argument with the man, Williams exclaimed, 'We were slaves. You just work like that as landscapers.' Several times during the outburst, Williams sang parts of the U.S. national anthem and chanted 'USA, USA, USA'. 'His comments were extremely inappropriate, particularly knowing the climate here in Arizona,' Maupin said. The state has been a political battleground in recent years over the passage of immigration reform legislation. 'He crossed the line with his comments about going back to Mexico, his comments about the historical aspects of how the Southwest became a part of the United States from Mexico,' Maupin said. 'Much of it didn't make sense, and that is the dangerous part of this'. Williams' 'flippant statements reflect poorly on the African-American community, and there's noticeable tension in our community,' he said. 'Celebrities' comments can lead to violence and tension in the community'. The written apology is not enough, Maupin said. 'I accept the apology if it's sincere, but his remarks were offensive'. The 'real test of his commitment' is Williams' willingness to do more. 'My challenge to him will be for him to return to show his face, to demonstrate his commitment to the Latino community and his commitment to civil rights,' he said. He suggested that comedian Tracey Morgan's return to Nashville, Tennessee, this summer to personally apologize for anti-gay remarks in a stand-up show there is an example of how Williams can make amends. 'We can meet in a church, we can meet in the Celebrity Theatre, wherever he feels comfortable,' Maupin said. Maupin said he was surprised by Williams' rant because his previous dealings with the comedian were positive. 'I have compassion for Katt Williams,' he said. 'It's up to him to let the community know if he's going through some personal or professional challenges'. Williams' often raunchy style has drawn comparisons to comedy legend Richard Pryor, but Maupin said there is a 'noticeable difference' in Pryor's joking about race and what Williams said in Phoenix. Williams began his career as a stand-up comic. His career breakthrough came with the 2006 HBO special 'Katt Williams: Pimp Chronicles Pt.1'. The last two years, however, have been highlighted by several arrests and other incidents at clubs. CNN's JD Cargill contributed to this report.

article_content: At Wimbledon on Wednesday, John Isner of the United States and Nicolas Mahut of France made tennis history by competing in the longest Grand Slam singles match ever recorded, which remains unfinished. The match was halted due to fading light at 59 games all in the fifth and deciding set, after 10 hours of play on Court 18 at the All England Club. During this marathon fifth set, the pair surpassed the previous record of six hours and 33 minutes, set at the 2004 French Open when Fabrice Santoro defeated Arnaud Clement 6-4, 6-3, 6-7, 3-6, 16-14. The fifth set's duration alone, currently seven hours and six minutes, exceeded the previous overall match record. Isner also achieved a world record for aces in a single match, serving 98, while Mahut delivered 95. A visibly exhausted Isner stated, 'Nothing like this will ever happen again, ever. I don't know what to say.' Isner held match point at 59-58, but Mahut saved it with an ace, leveling the score. Officials suspended play at 9:10 pm local time, despite Isner's desire to continue. Mahut, appearing less fatigued, commented, 'We played for too long, I don't know how many hours we played.' The first-round match, interrupted the previous night due to poor light, remained unfinished 24 hours later. Initially watched by a small crowd of under 800, news of the extraordinary final set spread, drawing fans and players eager to witness a remarkable moment in sports history. Defending champion Roger Federer remarked, 'This is beyond anything I've ever seen. It's absolutely amazing. I have almost no words anymore watching this. I don't know how their bodies must be feeling. This is incredible tennis. Someone has to lose, but in this match both will be winners.' Tournament organizers face a scheduling challenge on Thursday, as both players are scheduled to begin their third-round matches, contingent on resolving their epic first-round encounter, which has spanned 163 games.

An dakatar da wasan saboda hasken rana ya fara dusashewa a wasanni 59 da 59 a zagaye na biyar kuma na ƙarshe, bayan awanni 10 da aka yi ana buga wasa a Court 18 a All England Club. Tsawon lokacin zagaye na biyar kaɗai, wanda a halin yanzu ya kai awanni bakwai da mintuna shida, ya zarce tarihin wasan gaba ɗaya da ya gabata. article_content: Shinzo Abe, Japan's former prime minister, might have a second opportunity at the job. Having served as the country's leader from 2006 to 2007, his Liberal Democratic Party is expected to regain power this weekend in national elections. Some investors anticipate that Abe's return will positively impact Japan's equity markets. 'Investors are pricing in much greater monetary easing,' stated Ben Collett, head of Japanese equities at Louis Capital Markets in Hong Kong. In mid-November, Abe proposed unlimited monetary easing to stimulate the economy. He also urged the Bank of Japan to increase its current 1% inflation target to a possible 3%. Since then, investors wagering on an Abe administration have driven the Tokyo Nikkei up by over 10%. However, Collett questions Abe's ability to implement more stimulus and suggests investors may not see concrete action. 'That's just talk to get into office. He's setting a boundary. I don't know how he'll achieve it.' Collett believes Abe's timing is 'quite fortuitous,' suggesting Japan's economy has 'hit bottom' and is poised for recovery. If Abe returns to office, he is anticipated to take a firmer stance against China than his predecessors, judging by his previous assertive leadership. Asia's two largest economies have been entangled in a months-long trade dispute due to conflicting territorial claims in the East China Sea. Both China and Japan claim a small group of islands, known as the Diaoyu Islands in Chinese and the Senkaku Islands in Japanese. On September 11, Japan nationalized the islands, causing significant unrest in China. As a result, Chinese consumers reduced their purchases of Japanese products. In October, Japan disclosed that its September exports to China had fallen by more than 14%. Collett indicated that a stronger stance against China could further strain trade relations and potentially weaken Japan's currency, the yen. 'In fact, Abe's comments may be intentionally aimed at destabilizing sentiment on the yen,' Collett added, noting that 'anything that reduces the yen's popularity as a safe haven' will benefit exporters. Japan's economy is heavily dependent on exporters, including prominent brands like Toyota, Sony, and Panasonic. A weaker currency allows Japan's exporters to earn more yen when they repatriate overseas profits back to Japan. Since mid-November, the yen has weakened by 5.2% as Abe's chances of returning to power have increased. Although many economists are becoming more pessimistic about Japan's economy, which has recently entered a recession, Collett remains optimistic. 'Japan has never looked better to me. I'm very, very optimistic about it,' Collett said. 'I'm hopeful for the market and the economy, and Abe's timing is solid.' 'He'll initiate a cycle of new industrial development -- a rebirth of heavy industry in Japan that includes energy, hi-tech, space exploration, and defense industries.'

article_content: In Rustenburg, South Africa, numerous miners disobeyed work orders this Friday, awaiting a response from management regarding their submitted grievances. Around one hundred employees at Anglo American Platinum in Rustenburg declined to start their shifts, insisting that the company address the demands they presented a week prior. According to a company statement, the miners returned to their jobs following discussions between management and six individuals chosen to represent the workforce. Both parties are committed to finding a solution. What triggered the tragic Marikana massacre? The company expressed satisfaction with the meeting's positive conclusion, praising the employees for prioritizing their safety and that of their colleagues. However, the statement did not specify if the talks yielded concrete results. This event is the most recent display of labor unrest in the country's mining region, located in the northwest. Across South Africa, memorial services were held on Thursday to honor the victims of the clashes at the Lonmin Marikana mine. Initially, the strikes were protests advocating for increased wages, but they escalated into one of the most devastating instances of violence in post-apartheid South Africa. These conflicts resulted in 44 fatalities, including 34 who died when police fired upon charging protesters on August 16. In the days leading up to this, an additional 10 individuals, including law enforcement officers, lost their lives. The situation was further complicated by the rivalry between two powerful unions within the nation. These unions, accused of competing to achieve higher wage agreements, have denied any involvement in inciting the conflicts. Besides the aforementioned companies, signs of worker dissatisfaction are also evident at the nearby Bafokeng Rasimone Platinum Mine. Approximately 1,000 workers demonstrated this week, expressing their discontent with their wages. They have since resumed their duties after a one-day protest. Fears of instability are now spreading to other mining operations in South Africa.

article_content: State of Origin coach Laurie Daley and Ray Hadley are embroiled in a heated dispute. The conflict stems from assistant Blues coach Matt Parish, who is accused of having a relationship with Hadley's estranged wife. Parish denies the alleged affair, stating that his relationship with Suzanne Hadley commenced after she filed an Apprehended Violence Order (AVO) against her husband in February. Speaking to The Daily Telegraph, Parish said, 'I didn't even know Suzanne before that. Whatever I am doing, it's my private life. It's being dragged through the mill by him (Hadley).' Hadley addressed the split from his wife Suzanne, calling it his 'biggest personal challenge'. Hadley is accused of attempting to have Parish removed from his position as assistant coach because of the relationship with Suzanne. He denies these claims. On his radio show, Hadley stated he was only trying to 'get some dignity from a very undignified situation'. He added, 'At times I've felt like staying in bed and not coming here [to work]. Listeners have to understand that despite the fact I'm on the wireless I face exactly the same problems off air as you do every day.' Daley asserts that Hadley is using his 'influence and power' to get Parish sacked after Parish was seen with Suzanne. Hadley reportedly contacted NSWRL CEO David Trodden to express his concerns. Despite this, Daley and Parish received unanimous support at a board meeting held following the phone call. Hadley mentioned having a supportive phone conversation with Daley, stating, 'He was very supportive and offered his friendship, that’s a friendship that has been in existence for almost 30 years. From my point of view nothing has changed.' Hadley also conveyed his well-wishes to his former wife: 'I've told my former wife previously and repeat today, I wish her well and hope she can find happiness.' Daley accuses Hadley of using his radio show to attack Parish. Hadley denies pressuring NSW officials to sack Parish but admits to speaking with Trodden about Parish and Suzanne. Hadley said, 'I simply asked Dave Trodden to advise Matt Parish to be more circumspect in matters involving my wife. I deny I asked for him to be sacked.' Hadley and Suzanne have been married since 1994 but are now separated following her AVO application and subsequent withdrawal. In a separate incident, Blues halfback Mitchell Pearce was involved in a nightclub altercation. Despite the incident, Pearce is expected to be named in the NSW team for the first Origin match on May 28. Hadley acknowledged speaking with NSWRL boss David Trodden about Matt Parish and his wife Suzanne.

article_content: Following his man-of-the-match performance in England's decisive Six Nations victory over Italy, Jonathan Joseph has issued a strong message to Ireland. At Twickenham, the Bath centre scored twice among England’s six tries, asserting that his best form is yet to come in the competition. England's next challenge is against Ireland in Dublin on March 1. This game is a clash between the only two unbeaten teams remaining, after Ireland's 18-11 victory over France at the Aviva Stadium. George Ford, Joseph's Bath teammate, contributed 15 points with his kicking. Joseph, 23, has been likened to the 'new Jeremy Guscott' due to his smooth running style and impressive finishing abilities. He commented that he feels honored by the comparison, recognizing Guscott's class and successful career with both Bath and England. The comparison stems from their shared agility and scoring prowess. Joseph's two tries highlighted his world-class performance for England against Italy at Twickenham. Including his try against Wales, Joseph now has a total of three tries in this year's RBS 6 Nations. Joseph emphasized the importance of hard work and humility, stating that he is still developing and aiming to improve. He expressed his joy at scoring two tries in England's win, but stressed the need to remain focused. After Mike Brown's early head injury, Joseph moved to the wing. This shift did not deter him. He noted his ability to play both centre and wing, though he prefers centre. He aims to perform consistently and acknowledged his hard work and training at Bath. Joseph credited George Ford for creating opportunities, helping him to score. Missing the opportunity to play in New Zealand last year was a motivating factor for Joseph. He explained that the disappointment fueled his determination. Despite injuries and a less-than-ideal season, seeing his friends play inspired him to strive for his goals. Joseph is determined to stay grounded before facing Ireland. England's 47-17 victory at Twickenham highlighted some early mistakes that need addressing. Looking ahead to the Ireland match, Joseph anticipates a tough challenge, requiring thorough preparation. Stuart Lancaster noted the team's initial lack of defensive intensity, particularly when Sergio Parisse scored. Lancaster admitted his disappointment with the defensive start, which improved in the second half, though the final try was frustrating. Despite this, Lancaster would have accepted scoring 47 points before the game, recognizing the difficulty of playing against Italy, as seen two years ago when the score was 18-11. Brown's injury was concerning, and Lancaster praised his bravery. Brown was unconscious following a collision and received treatment before being stretchered off. He reappeared later and will follow return-to-play protocols before being considered for the Ireland game. Lancaster described the incident as dangerous, acknowledging Brown's bravery. Brown is now communicating well but is frustrated to be missing the game. He will not participate in the upcoming training week, with his progress being monitored before the Ireland game. Brown's injury has highlighted concerns about head injuries in rugby. Before the Ireland match, Joseph hopes England can reduce errors. Lancaster praised Joseph's performance despite initial concerns with the team's play. George Ford and Joseph appear to have a strong on-field connection, evident in their try celebration. Italy struggled to contain Joseph, and Ireland will likely be cautious of him. Mike Brown was bleeding from his nose due to the head injury he sustained.

article_content: Heidi Griffins, a 15-year-old, experienced significant improvement in her severe spinal curvature, despite initial predictions she might never fully straighten. Diagnosed with scoliosis three years prior, after a P.E. teacher noticed a protruding shoulder, Heidi, an avid tennis enthusiast, faced a recommendation for surgery as the primary treatment. Instead of undergoing surgery to implant metal rods and fuse her spine, Heidi's mother, Clare, sought alternative treatments, eventually finding the Scoliosis SOS clinic in London. This clinic, established over seven years ago by Erika Maude, a former scoliosis patient, provides exercises to improve posture. The exercise regimens are tailored to the condition's severity. Within one week of an intensive four-week program, Heidi felt reduced back pain and better breathing. 'When I learned about my scoliosis, I didn't really grasp it,' said Heidi, who is from Durham. 'The SOS clinic was the first to explain what was happening in my back.' Choosing the exercise program over surgery allowed Heidi to become pain-free and resume playing tennis. 'The SOS clinic staff were amazing and made me feel normal again,' she stated. 'Hospital specialists had cautioned against overexertion, but the clinic encouraged me to live actively.' Heidi explained, 'The exercises were manageable, requiring focus. I always give my best effort, which I believe contributed to my success. I'm eager to play tennis again.' Heidi and her family are now dedicated to increasing scoliosis awareness and promoting non-surgical alternatives. Scoliosis is characterized by an S-shaped spinal curve. Symptoms include a visible spinal curve, uneven shoulders or hips, ill-fitting clothes, and back pain. Adults usually experience pain more than children. Often, the cause is unknown, though cerebral palsy and muscular dystrophy can contribute. In the UK, it affects 3-4 in 1,000 children and up to 70% of individuals over 65. It's more prevalent in women. Mild cases often self-correct, but severe cases might require a brace or surgery. Adult treatment focuses on pain management. (Source: NHS Choices)

An gano tana da scoliosis shekaru uku da suka gabata, bayan da malamin motsa jiki ya lura da kafadarta na fitowa, Heidi, mai sha'awar wasan tennis, ta fuskanci shawarar yin aiki a matsayin babban magani. Maimakon yin aiki don saka sandunan ƙarfe da haɗa kashin bayanta, mahaifiyar Heidi, Clare, ta nemi hanyoyin magani na daban, daga ƙarshe ta sami asibitin Scoliosis SOS a Landan. Wannan asibitin, wanda Erika Maude, tsohuwar mai fama da scoliosis ta kafa fiye da shekaru bakwai da suka gabata, yana ba da motsa jiki don inganta matsayi. Ana daidaita tsarin motsa jiki da tsananin yanayin. A cikin mako guda na shirin makonni huɗu mai zurfi, Heidi ta ji ƙarancin ciwon baya da kuma inganta numfashi. 'Lokacin da na koyi game da scoliosis dina, ban fahimci komai ba,' in ji Heidi, wanda ya fito daga Durham. 'Asibitin SOS shi ne na farko da ya bayyana abin da ke faruwa a bayana.' Zaɓin shirin motsa jiki a kan aiki ya ba Heidi damar zama ba tare da jin zafi ba kuma ta ci gaba da buga wasan tennis. 'Ma'aikatan asibitin SOS sun kasance masu ban mamaki kuma sun sa na ji kamar na al'ada,' in ji ta. 'Masana a asibiti sun yi gargadin kada a yi aiki da yawa, amma asibitin ya ƙarfafa ni in rayu cikin aiki.' Heidi ta bayyana, 'Motsa jikin yana da sauƙi, yana buƙatar mai da hankali. Kullum ina ba da mafi kyawun ƙoƙari na, wanda na yi imani ya ba da gudummawa ga nasarata. Ina ɗokin sake buga wasan tennis.' Heidi da danginta a yanzu sun sadaukar da kansu don ƙara wayar da kan jama'a game da scoliosis da haɓaka hanyoyin da ba na tiyata ba. Scoliosis yana da siffa ta kashin baya mai siffar S. Alamomin sun haɗa da lanƙwasa na kashin baya da ake gani, kafadu ko kwatangwalo marasa daidaituwa, tufafi marasa kyau, da ciwon baya. Manya galibi suna fuskantar ciwo fiye da yara. Sau da yawa, ba a san dalilin ba, kodayake cerebral palsy da muscular dystrophy na iya ba da gudummawa. A Burtaniya, yana shafar yara 3-4 cikin 1,000 da kuma kusan kashi 70% na mutanen da suka haura 65. Ya fi yawa a cikin mata. Sau da yawa lokuta masu laushi suna gyara kansu, amma lokuta masu tsanani na iya buƙatar takalmi ko aiki. Maganin manya yana mai da hankali kan sarrafa ciwo. (Madogararsa: NHS Choices)

If you're tired of pizza and not in the mood for curry, consider a restaurant specializing in insect-based dishes. Eat Ento, a pop-up restaurant launching a three-night event in south London, features honey caterpillar canapés, grasshopper dumpling consommé with locust jus, and burnt bee larvae on its menu.

This innovative menu comes from four graduates who describe themselves as 'iconoclasts of taste,' aiming to make insects a regular part of the Western diet.

Feeling hungry? This new London pop-up restaurant offers grasshoppers, locusts, and worms on its menu.

The Eat Ento team emphasizes that insects are a valuable food source for the world's growing population. Aran Dasan, Jonathan Fraser, Julene Aguirre, and Jacky Chung state that edible insects are a 'healthy, tasty, and sustainable source of protein.' Their initial plan is to encourage people to enjoy eating insects, followed by opening a permanent restaurant. Their ultimate goal is to have insect products available in supermarkets within seven years.

Aguirre said, 'With your interest and lots of cooking and farming, we believe insect dishes could be a regular sight in your local supermarket by 2020.'

The students, who conceived the idea during their design, innovation, and engineering course at London's Royal College Of Art, hope their restaurant will 'gently challenge our cultural taboo' regarding eating insects. This involves educating people about their benefits.

Fraser noted, 'We think people should know that insects are not only more space- and energy-efficient than traditional livestock but also high in protein and nutrients like omega-3 while remaining low in fat and cholesterol.'

They assert that insects prefer close living conditions and consume less food than cattle or sheep, thus raising fewer ethical farming concerns. Packed with protein, zinc, calcium, and iron, edible insects are already part of the diet for millions worldwide.

Insects are considered to pose a lower risk of transmitting infections to humans compared to other mammals. Furthermore, food production needs to double to sustain our rapidly increasing population in the coming decades. However, the key to persuading people to consume insects is to make what the students call insect cuisine appealing.

One of Eat Ento's dishes is a grasshopper and honey caterpillar medallion, where honey caterpillars are blended and fried into a thin crepe, then rolled around fresh carrot, radish, and cucumber sticks to create a canapé similar to a spring roll. Other offerings include watermelon with caterpillar risotto and ground cricket, along with grasshopper dumpling consommé, scorched tofu, and locust jus for those who enjoy Chinese cuisine.

Fraser told The Times, 'People assume the strength of the taboo is going to be reflected in the taste of the food, but it's not.'

Eat Ento isn't the only London restaurant featuring insects. Pest control firm Rentokil is also launching a pop-up 'pestaurant' in the City, offering dishes like salt and vinegar crickets, chocolate-dipped ants, and sweet chili pigeon burgers (which are slightly less daunting).

The food will be free, and diners can ask the pest control experts present any questions they have on the subject. A Rentokil spokesman stated, 'Edible insects have recently been identified by various bodies, including the UN’s Food & Agriculture Organisation, as a potentially valuable food source for the world’s rapidly growing population.'

'Many insects are rich in protein, zinc, calcium, and iron while also being low in fat. They also have a high ‘feed conversion rate,’ meaning they can be farmed using relatively little land, water, and energy compared to livestock.'

Pigeons, despite being a nuisance for many, are recognized as a delicacy, with wood pigeon appearing on Michelin-starred menus globally. Proponents of insect cuisine hope to emulate the success of sushi, which was once viewed with skepticism by Westerners but is now a staple for British office workers.

article_content: BRUSSELS – The European Union has long understood the significance of food to France. Therefore, interfering with Camembert is a sensitive issue. On Wednesday, members of the European Parliament ensured that this interference won't happen soon. Within a proposal aimed at streamlining waste management across the 27-nation bloc, some French cheese producers detected a potential issue and voiced their concerns. They argued that the proposal's wording could prohibit the aging and sale of Camembert in its traditional wooden packaging. The round wooden box is integral to Camembert, as much as its creamy texture and strong aroma. The fear arose that a fundamental aspect of French culture would be impacted by Brussels bureaucrats, often criticized for various issues. Jean-Paul Garraud, a French member of the European Parliament from the far-right Rassemblement National, stated, “It is a matter of common sense. Don’t touch our Camemberts!” The concern was that forcing Camembert into recyclable plastic might hinder the cheese's natural breathing process, resulting in a less desirable product. However, wood is difficult to recycle sustainably, and the EU aims to reduce its use in food packaging. Environment Commissioner Virginijus Sinkevicius clarified before Wednesday's vote that raw-milk, specialized, non-industrial Camemberts with a controlled designation of origin would be exempt from the regulation. Even Gen. Charles de Gaulle, the former French president, recognized these gourmet sensitivities, famously asking, “How do you want to run a country that has 246 kinds of cheese?” Wednesday's vote demonstrated that cheese can unite, as European legislators from various political backgrounds supported an amendment allowing wooden boxes in specific cases. Valerie Hayer, a French legislator from Renew Europe, celebrated, “We have saved our Camemberts,” adding that other cheeses like Pont l’Évêque and Mont d’Or would also be protected. The center-right European People's Party, with its focus on farming and heritage, spearheaded the defense of wooden boxes for Camembert and other cheeses. Laurence Sailliet, a French MEP, argued, “Who can imagine a Camembert or a Mont d’Or without its wooden strapping? Packaging them in plastic would be a gustatory and environmental aberration. Europe must protect the environment, but not at the expense of its member states' unique characteristics.” Food is undeniably a sensitive characteristic. The British extensively used anti-EU food rhetoric leading up to Brexit. Boris Johnson, then a Brussels journalist, famously reported on the EU's alleged plans to standardize bananas and eliminate British biscuits, contributing to the UK's decision to leave the EU.

Har ila yau, Janar Charles de Gaulle, tsohon shugaban Faransa, ya gane waɗannan abubuwan jin daɗin gourmet, ya shahara da tambayar, “Yaya kuke son gudanar da ƙasar da ke da nau'ikan cuku guda 246?” Jefa ƙuri'ar ranar Laraba ta nuna cewa cuku na iya haɗa kai, yayin da 'yan majalisar Turai daga fannoni daban-daban na siyasa suka goyi bayan gyara da ke ba da izinin akwatin katako a wasu yanayi. Valerie Hayer, 'yar majalisar Faransa daga Renew Europe, ta yi murna, “Mun ceci Camembert ɗinmu,” ta ƙara da cewa wasu cuku kamar Pont l’Évêque da Mont d’Or suma za a kiyaye su. Laurence Sailliet, ɗan MEP na Faransa, ya bayar da hujjar cewa, “Wanene zai iya tunanin Camembert ko Mont d’Or ba tare da ɗamara ta katako ba? Shirya su a cikin filastik zai zama karkatacciyar abu da ta muhalli. Dole ne Turai ta kare muhalli, amma ba tare da sadaukar da keɓantattun halayen ƙasashen membobinta ba.” Abinci ba za a iya musun cewa halayya ce mai mahimmanci ba. 'Yan Burtaniya sun yi amfani da kalaman adawa da abinci na EU sosai kafin Brexit. Boris Johnson, wanda a lokacin ɗan jarida ne a Brussels, ya ba da rahoto game da zargin EU na shirye-shiryen daidaita ayaba da kawar da biscuits na Burtaniya, wanda ya ba da gudummawa ga shawarar Burtaniya na barin EU.

article_content: Fitness expert James Duigan, known for his Clean & Lean approach and the Bodyism gym in London, is tackling arm fat. Celebrities like Rosie Huntington-Whiteley swear by his methods. This article, part of an exclusive series, reveals exercises for achieving toned arms, reminiscent of Michelle Obama. Duigan suggests three simple, equipment-free exercises that can be done anywhere. These include the 'Y' exercise for posture and arm toning, closed-grip push-ups from the knees, and floor tricep dips, which also benefit the legs, stomach, and glutes. He recommends performing 15 repetitions of each exercise daily. Duigan's Clean & Lean plan, initially introduced in a 2012 book and now available as an e-book, promotes a diet of fresh, natural foods. It advises minimizing refined sugar, limiting caffeine, and avoiding alcohol. The plan's popularity stems from its effectiveness, spread through positive word-of-mouth. Model Rosie Huntington-Whiteley praises Duigan's ability to help her achieve a lean, strong, and feminine physique through healthy habits. She even wrote the introduction to his book. Beyond diet, the article notes that stress can cause weight gain. Stress triggers the release of hormones like cortisol, which leads to increased fat storage, especially around the abdomen. Therefore, managing stress is crucial for a healthy body. The Clean & Lean Diet is available for download on amazon.co.uk (£5.99) and amazon.com ($9.56).

article_content: This significant deal solidifies Raheem Sterling's position as Liverpool's key player for years to come. At just 20 years old, Sterling is set to sign a lucrative five-year contract worth £25 million. But how does this England star rank among the most promising young talents in Europe's top leagues? Here's our countdown of the top 10. 10. Jetro Willems (PSV Eindhoven and Netherlands): Willems, the most experienced on our list, began playing in the Eredivisie with Sparta Rotterdam while still a teenager. His move to PSV Eindhoven propelled his career, and the 20-year-old left-back is now a regular for the Dutch national team. Notably, he was the youngest player to ever play in a European Championship final in 2012, at 18 years and 71 days. 9. Max Meyer (Schalke and Germany): Meyer, the latest talented attacking midfielder from Germany, is often compared to Mario Gotze. The 19-year-old Schalke player attributes his progress to the close control and movement skills he developed playing futsal as a youth. Meyer is a key player for Schalke, with 68 appearances, and has also earned a cap for Germany. 8. Ross Barkley (Everton and England): At only 21, Barkley has become a mainstay for both Everton and the England national team, and he's likely to remain so. The midfielder's rare combination of strength, pace, and technique allows him to dominate games, a quality he consistently demonstrates. Approaching 100 appearances for Everton and with 10 caps for England, Barkley is rumored to be considering a high-profile transfer. 7. Saul Niguez (Atletico Madrid and Spain): Touted as Spain's next great midfielder, Saul progressed through Atletico Madrid's youth system after joining from Real Madrid at age 14. A loan spell at Rayo Vallecano proved crucial, contributing significantly to their impressive 12th-place finish in La Liga. An Under-21 international for Spain, Saul is known for his uncompromising tackling, quick thinking, and excellent game reading. 6. Mateo Kovacic (Inter Milan and Croatia): The versatile Croatian international Kovacic, 20, is attracting interest from top Premier League clubs, having already achieved considerable experience. He played 73 times for Dinamo Zagreb before joining Inter Milan in 2012, where he has since added another 73 appearances. Throughout his career, he has played both defensive and advanced midfield positions, excelling in both due to his accomplished dribbling and passing abilities. 5. Hakan Calhanoglu (Bayer Leverkusen and Turkey): At just 20 years old, Calhanoglu is considered Europe's best free-kick specialist, consistently impressing in the Bundesliga with his set-piece skills. He moved from Hamburg to Bayer Leverkusen for £12m and has scored seven goals in domestic and European competitions. Highly regarded, Germany wanted Calhanoglu to represent them, but he chose to play for Turkey, his parents' country, earning five caps so far. 4. Gerard Deulofeu (Sevilla, on loan from Barcelona, and Spain): Premier League fans are well acquainted with Deulofeu following his impressive loan spell with Everton last season. Barcelona loaned the 20-year-old to Sevilla, prompting many to question why Luis Enrique didn't keep him. Deulofeu's speed and direct attacking style, whether on the wing or further forward, make him an exciting player to watch. 3. Adrien Rabiot (Paris Saint-Germain and France): As one of Europe's most sought-after young players, Rabiot is attracting interest from numerous top Premier League clubs due to his struggle for regular playing time at PSG. This is frustrating for the highly-rated 19-year-old midfielder, whose on-pitch command, skill, and precise passing belie his age. Having represented France up to Under-21 level, Rabiot is likely to advance to the senior team if he gains consistent playing time, possibly in England. 2. Raheem Sterling (Liverpool and England): Gifted with exceptional ball control and incredible speed, Sterling was a key part of Liverpool's Premier League title challenge last season and is arguably English football's brightest prospect. At just 20, Sterling has already achieved a great deal, including over 100 appearances and 18 goals for Liverpool, and 13 caps for England. His accomplishments have been recognized, as Sterling recently won the Golden Boy Award for Europe's best young player. 1. Munir El Haddadi (Barcelona and Spain): Barcelona clearly believes Munir, their 19-year-old prodigy, is ready, having featured him in several matches this season. As he consistently demonstrated in Barcelona's youth ranks, the La Masia graduate possesses exceptional footwork, quick thinking, confidence, and a willingness to shoot. He is now showcasing these qualities against La Liga and Champions League defenses, promising many successful years ahead.

Hakan Calhanoglu (Bayer Leverkusen da Turkey): Yana da shekaru 20 kacal, ana ɗaukar Calhanoglu a matsayin ƙwararren mai bugun daga kai sai mai tsaron gida a Turai, yana burge mutane akai-akai a Bundesliga da ƙwarewar sa na bugun daga kai sai mai tsaron gida. Adrien Rabiot (Paris Saint-Germain da Faransa): A matsayinsa na ɗaya daga cikin fitattun matasan 'yan wasa a Turai, Rabiot yana jan hankalin manyan ƙungiyoyin Premier League saboda gwagwarmayar da yake yi na samun damar buga wasa akai-akai a PSG. This act triggered a wide range of reactions, with many expressing support for al-Zaidi, notably on social media platforms like Facebook. While some hail al-Zaidi as a hero who boldly championed free speech, others view his actions as a sign of disrespect. The unusual shoe-throwing incident quickly became a topic of discussion and comedic fodder in popular culture.

article_content: In a London court, allegations have surfaced against police officers responsible for protecting the British royal family, accusing them of handling firearms while intoxicated, trading pornography and steroids, and posing comically on Queen Elizabeth II's throne. The accusations center around the conduct of officers formerly tasked with security at Buckingham Palace. These allegations were presented on Tuesday by John Cooper, the lawyer representing Paul Page, a former royal protection officer accused of defrauding colleagues and friends to finance a lavish lifestyle, according to The British Press Association. The PA reports that the claims arose during the cross-examination of Adam McGregor, a former colleague of Page who left his position at Buckingham Palace in London in 2005. McGregor has accused Page of defrauding him of thousands of dollars. Cooper suggested that there was a practice among armed officers at the palace where one officer would sleep while others maintained watch for their supervisor. McGregor denied any knowledge of this practice or any other alleged misconduct among his colleagues at the royal residence. When questioned further, McGregor admitted to sitting on one of the thrones but denied striking any 'comical poses.' The court also learned that officers protecting the royals lost over £250,000 ($365,800) in a spread betting venture known as 'The Currency Club,' reportedly one of several ostensibly successful schemes Page allegedly established to pay off escalating debts, according to PA. The BBC reports that Page allegedly obtained approximately £3 million ($4.4 million) from about 57 lenders or investors. Cooper implied that McGregor was 'one of those police officers' who used mobile patrols to deliver cash to other Royal Protection officers involved in financial dealings. McGregor denied this accusation as well. Instead, McGregor claimed he had been 'totally sucked in' by Page. He described Page as 'a very charismatic person' and admitted to acting 'very naively and very stupidly' in his dealings with his former colleague. The prosecution argued that Page's wife promptly laundered much of the money before it was gambled away. They alleged that Page concealed his dishonesty behind a 'veneer of credibility,' supported by a collection of expensive cars and claims of being a highly 'adept' property developer and market speculator, PA reported. Page, a 37-year-old father of five from Essex, England, has pleaded not guilty to five charges: two counts of fraudulent trading, one count of intimidation, threatening revenge, and making a threat to kill between January 1, 2003, and March 30, 2007. His wife, Laura, 42, has denied charges of 'being concerned in an arrangement facilitating dealings with criminal property,' intimidation, and threatening to kill.

McGregor ya musanta wannan zargin ma. A maimakon haka, McGregor ya yi iƙirarin cewa Page ne ya 'shanye shi gaba daya'. Page, mai shekaru 37, uba na yara biyar daga Essex, Ingila, ya musanta laifuka biyar: laifuka biyu na cinikin zamba, laifi ɗaya na tsoratarwa, yin barazanar ɗaukar fansa, da yin barazanar kisa tsakanin 1 ga Janairu, 2003, da 30 ga Maris, 2007. Matarsa, Laura, mai shekaru 42, ta musanta zargin 'shiga cikin wata hanya da ke sauƙaƙe mu'amala da kadarorin aikata laifuka,' tsoratarwa, da kuma barazanar kisa.

article_content: The RSVP has been sent, the hotel booked, and transport arranged, so the only thing left is — whisper it — the outfit. With July upon us, the month that hosts more weddings than any other, chances are there’s still some what-do-I-wear panic among the less organized — especially as ceremonies are becoming ever more elaborate and held in increasingly unusual locations. Here, Femail fashion editor Eliza Scarborough shows you how to dress for any occasion. Consider the elements when dressing for a beach wedding — sun, sea, and sand don’t suit super-high heels and feathered fascinators. Pair kitten heels with a floppy hat. A short jacket will protect you from gusty conditions, and these jolly stripes give a nice nod to nautical style. A chic dress with sparkly accessories gives understated glamour. An embellished Alice band is a relaxed alternative to a hat or fascinator. Here's quintessential British style — a classic hat and dress. As the least formal type of wedding, you can wear a strappy dress and bare shoulders. A hat isn't mandatory, but it could shield you from the sun. Try something modern for a service in the city, like this tailored jumpsuit. You’ll need to look smart, so wear a statement hat and a jacket. Say goodbye to stiletto heels for this relaxed affair: a pair of metallic flats adds just the right amount of glamour to a pretty mesh dress. EVENING EVENT A black-tie evening wedding usually requires dressy attire. This calls for a sleek silhouette and glittering accessories. Avoid hemlines that stop above the knee; this is the occasion for a floor-skimming gown. Hats or fascinators should be avoided — a statement necklace or glittery hair slide works better instead.

Yi la'akari da yanayin wajen yin ado don bikin aure a bakin teku - rana, teku, da yashi ba su dace da manyan takalma masu tsini da manyan huluna masu ado ba. Haɗa takalma masu ɗan gajeren tsini da hula mai laushi. Ƙaramar riga za ta kare ku daga yanayin iska, kuma waɗannan zane-zane masu daɗi suna ba da sha'awa ga salon na ruwa. article_content: During this year's Republican National Convention, Republicans heavily referenced President Barack Obama's July comment, 'You didn't build that'. Republicans interpreted the phrase – taken from Obama's campaign speech in Virginia – as revealing his opposition to free enterprise. The phrase 'We Built It' served as a backdrop during the convention, with speakers characterizing Obama as a detached, big-government liberal. GOP Chairman Reince Priebus stated, 'That makes me think that Barack Obama has a problem with the American dream... He said, 'You didn't build it.' Translation: 'It doesn't rightly belong to you.' Former Arkansas governor Mike Huckabee commented similarly. House Speaker John Boehner shared an anecdote about a bar patron whose business success was questioned. Vice presidential nominee Paul Ryan, in his acceptance speech, praised small business owners, stating, 'Yes, you did build that.' Edited clips of Obama's remarks were presented at the convention, featuring business owners who disagreed with his statement. Obama's full remark, delivered in Roanoke, Virginia, defended government's role in economic growth. He stated, 'If you've been successful, you didn't get there on your own... Somebody invested in roads and bridges... The Internet didn't get invented on its own. Government research created the Internet...' Obama responded to the criticism, emphasizing the need to support hardworking Americans through investments in education, training, roads, and research. He refuted the edited versions of his remarks as inaccurate. The article concludes that the remark was taken out of context. CNN's Matt Smith, Amy Roberts, and Christine Brazill contributed to this report.

'Yan Republican sun fassara wannan jumlar – wadda aka ɗauko daga jawabin yaƙin neman zaɓen Obama a Virginia – a matsayin bayyana adawarsa ga kasuwanci mai zaman kansa. Jumlar 'Mun Gina Ta' ta zama abin da aka yi amfani da ita a lokacin taron, inda masu magana suka bayyana Obama a matsayin mai nisa, mai sassaucin ra'ayi na gwamnati. Shugaban GOP Reince Priebus ya bayyana cewa, 'Wannan ya sa na yi tunanin cewa Barack Obama yana da matsala game da mafarkin Amurka... Ya ce, 'Ba ku gina ta ba.' Fassara: 'Ba ta dace da ku ba.' Tsohon gwamnan Arkansas Mike Huckabee ya yi tsokaci makamancin haka. Kakakin majalisar wakilai John Boehner ya ba da labari game da wani majiɓinci a mashaya wanda aka tambayi nasarar kasuwancinsa. Dan takarar mataimakin shugaban ƙasa Paul Ryan, a cikin jawabin karɓar takararsa, ya yaba wa masu kananan sana'o'i, yana mai cewa, 'Ee, kun gina wannan.' An gabatar da shirye-shiryen bidiyo da aka gyara na kalaman Obama a taron, waɗanda suka haɗa da masu kasuwanci waɗanda ba su yarda da maganarsa ba. Cikakken bayanin Obama, wanda aka gabatar a Roanoke, Virginia, ya kare rawar da gwamnati ke takawa a ci gaban tattalin arziki. Ya bayyana cewa, 'Idan kun yi nasara, ba ku samu a kan kanku ba... Wani ya saka hannun jari a hanyoyi da gadoji... Ba a ƙirƙira Intanet da kanta ba. Binciken gwamnati ya ƙirƙira Intanet...' Obama ya mayar da martani ga sukar, yana mai jaddada buƙatar tallafa wa 'yan Amurka masu aiki tuƙuru ta hanyar saka hannun jari a fannin ilimi, horo, hanyoyi, da bincike. Ya musanta nau'ikan da aka gyara na kalaman nasa a matsayin marasa daidai. Labarin ya kammala da cewa an ɗauki maganar daga mahallinta. Matt Smith, Amy Roberts, da Christine Brazill na CNN sun ba da gudummawa ga wannan rahoton.

article_content: Jeff Bezos, the founder of Amazon, is relocating to Miami just three weeks after acquiring a seven-bedroom mansion on a small private island in Biscayne Bay. The tech entrepreneur, who has been based in Seattle since 1994, stated that he is moving to be closer to his parents and to Blue Origin's facilities in Cape Canaveral, Florida. He announced the move on his Instagram account on Thursday. 'I've lived in Seattle longer than I've lived anywhere else and have so many amazing memories here. As exciting as the move is, it's an emotional decision for me,' Bezos, the world's third-richest person with a $161 billion net worth, wrote. Bezos' departure from Seattle is noteworthy because Amazon transformed the city into a major tech hub since establishing its headquarters there. Bezos launched Amazon in 1994 from the garage of his rented house in Bellevue, Washington, following a road trip from New York to Seattle. Last month, Bezos purchased the property in Indian Creek, Florida, for $79 million, Bloomberg reported. The transaction was finalized on October 12, according to real-estate news outlet The Real Deal, citing the Multiple Listing Service database. The property's sales listing describes the nearly two-acre mansion as exuding 'timeless European glamour' and notes that it was built in 2000. It includes a home theater, a library, a pool, and a wine cellar. This purchase is adjacent to another property Bezos acquired this summer for $68 million. Indian Creek is nicknamed 'Billionaire Bunker' due to its extremely affluent residents. Zillow identified it as the most expensive neighborhood in the US in 2021. The private island has strict security measures and is heavily guarded, Insider's Hannah Towey reported in December 2022 after touring the area. Residents also include investor Carl Icahn, Jared Kushner, and Ivanka Trump. Amazon and Bezos did not immediately respond to a request for comment from Insider sent outside regular business hours. Thursday, November 3, 11.02 a.m.: This story has been updated with Bezos' updated net worth, details of his real-estate purchase in Indian Creek, and background on Amazon's founding.

Dan kasuwar fasahar, wanda ke zaune a Seattle tun 1994, ya bayyana cewa yana ƙaura don ya kusanci iyayensa da wuraren Blue Origin a Cape Canaveral, Florida. Kamar yadda ƙaurar ke da ban sha'awa, shawara ce mai cike da tausayi a gare ni,' in ji Bezos, mutum na uku mafi arziki a duniya mai darajar dalar Amurka biliyan 161.
